svg.text: ESP32-C3 SuperMini to the Quectel LC29H(AA) board
Both boards seen from their component side, SuperMini USB-C up. Pin order is as on the GPS board; see the notes.
Supply: 5 V. Default UART speed: 115200 baud.
ESP32 RX from GPS TX (NMEA / UBX)
ESP32 TX to GPS RX (commands, RTCM corrections), through 1 kΩ with 5.6 kΩ to ground
Leave disconnected on the GPS board
1.8 V debug UART: 3.3 V exceeds its rating
test points beside the header: probe pads, not connections
The board drawing: Component side, header on the left, laid out from a photo of the board (2026-09-27). Not to
V takes 5 V: the board has its own regulator. (Inferred from the regulator on the board; check the listing.)
R1 is a 2.8 V input, 3.08 V absolute maximum. 1 kΩ in series and 5.6 kΩ to ground give 2.8 V from GPIO4.
Never connect T2 or R2. They are a 1.8 V debug port and 3.3 V exceeds their rating.
